spec.name: Garage - SOK
spec.description: The garage's packs, from their own battery management systems.

queries.query:
// One row per pack, its newest readings in the last thirty days. "read" is
// how long ago the pack last answered, so a pack that stopped stays listed
// with its last values. Alarms names each protection state the pack reports.

import "math"
import "strings"

alarms = (v) =>
    strings.trimSuffix(
    v:
        (if v / 1 % 2 == 1 then "cell over volts, " else "") +
        (if v / 2 % 2 == 1 then "full, " else "") +
        (if v / 4 % 2 == 1 then "charge high, " else "") +
        (if v / 8 % 2 == 1 then "too warm to charge, " else "") +
        (if v / 16 % 2 == 1 then "too cold to charge, " else "") +
        (if v / 32 % 2 == 1 then "board hot, charging, " else "") +
        (if v / 64 % 2 == 1 then "cell under volts, " else "") +
        (if v / 128 % 2 == 1 then "empty, " else "") +
        (if v / 256 % 2 == 1 then "charge low, " else "") +
        (if v / 512 % 2 == 1 then "too warm to discharge, " else "") +
        (if v / 1024 % 2 == 1 then "too cold to discharge, " else "") +
        (if v / 2048 % 2 == 1 then "board hot, discharging, " else "") +
        (if v / 4096 % 2 == 1 then "short circuit, " else "") +
        (if v / 8192 % 2 == 1 then "over current, " else "") +
        (if v / 16384 % 2 == 1 then "pack under volts, " else "") +
        (if v / 32768 % 2 == 1 then "pack over volts, " else "") +
        (if v >= 65536 then "other bits " + string(v: v - v % 65536) + ", " else ""),
    suffix: ", ",
)

ago = (t) => string(v: duration(v: (int(v: now()) - int(v: t)) / 1000000000 * 1000000000))

latest = from(bucket: "raw")
    |> range(start: -30d)
    |> filter(
        fn: (r) =>
            r._measurement == "garage" and r.location == "rack"
                and
                r._field =~ /^(state_of_charge_pct|pack_volts|pack_amps|cell_spread_volts|temp_[0-9]+|cycles|charge_mosfet_on|discharge_mosfet_on|heater_on|alarm_flags|commands_unanswered)$/,
    )
    |> last()

states = latest
    |> map(
        fn: (r) =>
            ({r with
                _value:
                    if r._field =~ /mosfet/ then
                        if r._value > 0.5 then "on" else "OFF"
                    else if r._field == "heater_on" then
                        if r._value > 0.5 then "on" else "off"
                    else if r._field == "alarm_flags" then
                        if r._value == 0.0 then "none" else alarms(v: int(v: r._value))
                    else if r._field == "cell_spread_volts" then
                        string(v: int(v: math.round(x: r._value * 1000.0)))
                    else if r._field == "pack_amps" or r._field == "pack_volts" or r._field =~ /^temp_/ then
                        string(v: math.round(x: r._value * 10.0) / 10.0)
                    else
                        string(v: int(v: math.round(x: r._value))),
            }),
    )

read = latest
    |> group(columns: ["device"])
    |> max(column: "_time")
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "read", _value: ago(t: r._time) + " ago"}))

union(tables: [states |> group(), read |> group()])
    |> keep(columns: ["device", "_field", "_value"])
    |> pivot(rowKey: ["device"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
    |> sort(columns: ["device"])

from(bucket: "raw")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "garage" and r.location == "rack" and r._field =~ /^state_of_charge_pct$/)
    |> group(columns: ["device", "_field"])
    |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "raw")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "garage" and r.location == "rack" and r._field =~ /^pack_amps$/)
    |> group(columns: ["device", "_field"])
    |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "raw")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "garage" and r.location == "rack" and r._field =~ /^cell_(min|max)_volts$/)
    |> group(columns: ["device", "_field"])
    |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "raw")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "garage" and r.location == "rack" and r._field =~ /^cell_spread_volts$/)
    |> group(columns: ["device", "_field"])
    |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 1000.0}))

from(bucket: "raw")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "garage" and r.location == "rack" and r._field =~ /^temp_[0-9]+$/)
    |> group(columns: ["device", "_field"])
    |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "raw")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "garage" and r.location == "rack" and r._field =~ /^pack_volts$/)
    |> group(columns: ["device", "_field"])
    |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
